levels.surface: الحسين بن ثوير بن أبي فاختة

notes: ruling needed (rule 11, a narrated encounter): the report is a first-person scene («قال كنت أنا ويونس ... جلوسا عند أبي عبد الله») in which the Imam speaks («قال إذا حضرتهم»); whether the Imam is a last link or only in the scene is not settled here, so the chain is written to Hussein ibn Thuwayr, the teller; «حدثني أبي» is a bare relation (rule 7); «رحمهم الله» is a blessing
